name: nyc-rsvps
description: Exact times when reservations open at popular New York City restaurants, with booking links and reminder handoff.

interface.longDescription:
NYC RSVPs tells you exactly when reservations open at about 70 of New York City's hardest-to-book restaurants, such as Carbone, Don Angie, Torrisi, Via Carota, and 4 Charles Prime Rib.

Each restaurant releases tables on its own schedule: a set number of days ahead, a calendar month ahead, on the 1st of the month, or twice a month. Tell ChatGPT the restaurant and the night you want, and NYC RSVPs gives the exact release time in New York time, whether booking is already open, and the booking platform (Resy, OpenTable, Tock, SevenRooms, and others).

Compare up to three restaurants for a date in a compact card, or browse up to six by cuisine or neighborhood to see how far ahead each one books. Tap Book when booking is open, or Remind me to ask ChatGPT for a reminder before tables are released.

NYC RSVPs does not book tables, hold reservations, or take payments, and it does not need an account. Release rules come from each restaurant's published policy and can change.
capabilities: Find tracked NYC restaurants by name, cuisine, neighborhood, or booking platform
Calculate the exact time reservations open for a dining date, in New York time
Show restaurants in a card: exact opening times for a date, or each release rule when browsing
Prepare reminder details so ChatGPT can set a reminder before tables open
defaultPrompt: When can I book Carbone, 4 Charles Prime Rib, or Don Angie for Saturday, December 12?
When do Don Angie reservations open for dinner on Saturday, December 12?
Which Italian restaurants in the West Village do you track, and how far ahead do they book?

positive.description: Compare several restaurants for one date
positive.prompt: When can I book Carbone, 4 Charles Prime Rib, or Don Angie for Saturday, December 12? Show me the options.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the card for Saturday, December 12 with three rows: Carbone opens Thu, Nov 12 at 10 AM ET (Resy), 4 Charles Prime Rib opens Sun, Nov 22 at 9 AM ET (Resy), Don Angie opens Sat, Dec 5 at 9 AM ET (OpenTable). Rows that are already open show Book; the others show Remind me.

positive.prompt: When do Don Angie reservations open for dinner on Saturday, December 12?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a one-row card: Don Angie opens Sat, Dec 5 at 9 AM ET on OpenTable, with a Remind me button. It does not claim to book a table.

positive.prompt: Which Italian restaurants in the West Village do you track, and how far ahead do they book?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a browse card with Don Angie (7 days), i Sodi (13 days), L'Artusi (14 days), and Via Carota (30 days), each with its release time in ET and a Book link.

positive.prompt: When do Lilia and Semma reservations open for Friday, December 11?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the card for Friday, December 11 with two rows: Lilia opens Fri, Nov 13 at 10 AM ET on Resy, and Semma opens Thu, Nov 26 at 9 AM ET on SevenRooms, each with a Remind me button.

positive.prompt: Which Korean restaurants do you track, and how far ahead do they book?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a browse card with Atoboy (29 days, midnight ET), COQODAQ (13 days, 10 AM ET), and Cote (29 days, 10 AM ET), each with a Book link to Resy.

negative.description: Booking request. NYC RSVPs cannot book or hold a table, so it must not claim a reservation was made.
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at Carbone tonight at 8.

negative.description: Outside New York City. The app only covers tracked NYC restaurants, so it should not act or should say the restaurant is not covered.
negative.prompt: When do reservations open at Noma in Copenhagen?

negative.description: Unrelated cooking question. The app has no relevant tools and should not be called.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for spicy rigatoni vodka.

review.commerce_description: NYC RSVPs does not sell products, process payments, or book reservations. Book links open the restaurant's own booking page.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search tracked NYC restaurants, exact reservation release times in New York time, a compact card with Book and Remind me actions, and reminder handoff.
